objective: AUDIT/integrity-scan.mjs chose each unit's canonical generation from a directory listing, ranking any untabled out* directory above the real out and recognising negative controls only by the substring negctl. FIX-2 carries two empty leftovers of control runs (out-noparent, out-tampered), which git cannot store, so in the checkout where those runs happened FIX-2 had no canonical record at all and its unresolved forward link to FIX-3 -- a record that was never emitted -- was filed as history rather than as an offender. The same committed tree (81e229a6, the merge of #616) reported offenders=2 beside the trail and offenders=3 in a fresh checkout of main. Make canonical mean the highest-ranked generation that actually holds a record, make named negative-control generations never canonical even when populated, and correct the series' chain-offender count from two to three.
